# Me Chess Book

Me Chess Book turns your Lichess games into a printable chess book, complete with annotated game pages and printable A4 or A5 layouts. It runs entirely in your browser: there are no accounts, no uploads and no cookies.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://chess-book.happypaul55.com/): what Me Chess Book does and how it works.
- [Make a book](https://chess-book.happypaul55.com/make): enter your Lichess username, choose A4 or A5, and generate your book.
- [How to print](https://chess-book.happypaul55.com/how-to-print): print-dialog settings for a clean chess book PDF.
- [Privacy](https://chess-book.happypaul55.com/privacy): how the site handles your data.
